title: CI, Hedef Ortam Uzlastirmasi ve Nihai Yayin Kapanisi

stages.title: CI ve workflow release gate uzlastirmasi
stages.objective: Checked-in GitHub workflows, workflow templates and release/deploy helpers must describe the same fail-closed CI contract; Phase 7's own contract test must be a required local and CI-visible gate.
stages.scope: Hosted sandbox product CI, migration gate, deploy gate, workflow templates, permissions, concurrency, artifact/fingerprint inputs, dry-run defaults, forbidden workflow patterns and the Phase 7 contract test.
prerequisites: Phase 6 state is CLOSED and its phase-7 transition gate is unlocked.
The current Git HEAD is readable and the three hosted-sandbox workflows exist.
The workflow hardening verifier and deploy contract are readable without mutating checked-in workflows.
No production, provider, channel or linked-Supabase mutation flag is enabled.
architectureDecisions: Workflow templates are the declared source and checked-in .github workflow files must have byte-identical content for each hosted-sandbox workflow.
Every workflow keeps read-only repository permissions, an explicit production-effects guard, bounded concurrency and a finite timeout.

Product CI must execute lint, production typecheck, hosted oracle tests, production build, release artifact construction, deploy machinery checks, workflow hardening, nginx validation, hosted contract validation and the Phase 7 contract test.
Migration apply remains an explicit manual boolean input with default false; the linked db push command is unreachable unless that input is true and the protected environment is granted.
Deploy workflow remains an artifact-gated dry-run; a remote apply path is not introduced by this phase.
GitHub workflow and target environment files are read or validated locally; no workflow dispatch is sent.
Production deployment, linked Supabase migration apply, remote restore, remote worker start and target writes are forbidden.
Real WhatsApp, Telegram, email, Stripe and external AI/provider egress remain disabled.
Only local build output, isolated temporary dry-run state and secret-free audit evidence may be written.
The phase may preserve a production NO-GO decision; technical closure must never be interpreted as production approval.
No commit, branch push, secret rotation or remote configuration change is performed by this phase.
operations: Read the Phase 6 closure and current HEAD; stop before the next operation if the transition gate is absent, stale or locked.
Enumerate the three checked-in hosted-sandbox workflows and three templates without running the workflow installer or overwriting user changes.
Verify permissions, checkout pinning, Node setup, timeout, concurrency and MANU_CI_NO_PRODUCTION_EFFECTS in every workflow.
Verify product CI contains lint, typecheck, oracle tests, build, artifact, deploy machinery, hardening, nginx, hosted verifier and Phase 7 contract gates in that order.
Verify migration apply is manual, default false, protected by environment and token/project-ref checks, and never runs during the local audit.
Verify deploy is protected by environment, migration fingerprint input, required release artifact and dry-run command; verify forbidden deploy patterns are absent.
Compare every checked-in workflow with its template and record source digests, changed files, dirty-tree state and secret-free blockers.
Run the read-only workflow hardening verifier and Phase 7 contract test; write the matrix and eight ordered operation results only after all earlier operations pass.
stages.dataFlow: workflow/template files -> normalized gate checks -> source digests -> CI release gate matrix -> local contract test -> stage evidence
verificationCriteria: required CI gates are ordered and present
migration and deploy gates are explicit and fail-closed
stages.completionCriteria: ci-release-gate-matrix.json status PASS, eight operation results PASS and stage evidence VERIFIED; otherwise 7.2 remains locked.

stages.title: Release kimligi, migrasyon parmak izi ve hedef ortam sozlesmesi
stages.objective: The release commit, migration fingerprint, compatibility version, target environment gates, health identity contract and existing owner handoff decision must agree without contacting or mutating a live target.
stages.scope: Release identity derivation, all SQL migration files, release health route, hosted deploy/migration inputs, schema contract probes, production readiness decision and target probe policy.
prerequisites: 7.1 is VERIFIED and its output/evidence digests match.
Release identity and migration fingerprint source files exist.
The production readiness decision is available and remains an authoritative NO-GO unless owner gates are explicitly completed.
The audit environment has no provider, channel, billing, production-schema or remote Supabase mutation flag enabled.
architectureDecisions: The release ID is derived from the exact 40-character HEAD SHA and the SHA-256 fingerprint of the sorted migration set.
A target probe is deliberately NOT_RUN_BY_POLICY in this local phase; historical or live health output cannot be promoted to current production evidence.
The declared production decision, owner actions and liveActionsExecuted list are reconciled as data, never silently changed by the audit.
Target environment URLs, project references and secret names may be recorded only as redacted metadata; secret values and response bodies are never persisted.
A dirty working tree and unresolved owner actions are release blockers in the final decision record, but do not invalidate the technical contract checks themselves.
GitHub workflow and target environment files are read or validated locally; no workflow dispatch is sent.
Production deployment, linked Supabase migration apply, remote restore, remote worker start and target writes are forbidden.
Real WhatsApp, Telegram, email, Stripe and external AI/provider egress remain disabled.
Only local build output, isolated temporary dry-run state and secret-free audit evidence may be written.
The phase may preserve a production NO-GO decision; technical closure must never be interpreted as production approval.
No commit, branch push, secret rotation or remote configuration change is performed by this phase.
operations: Read and digest 7.1 evidence before accessing any target reconciliation source.
Derive the current release identity and migration fingerprint from HEAD and the sorted SQL migration set.
Verify the release health route, service-worker identity contract and migration/schema probe definitions expose the same identity fields.
Verify the hosted migration and deploy workflows carry the fingerprint, commit and artifact gates required to bind a target to one release.
Read the production readiness decision and record owner actions, liveActionsExecuted, productionDecision and mustNotClaim without modifying the decision.
Record target URLs and environment profile metadata without making HTTP, Supabase, SSH, provider or channel calls; set targetProbe to NOT_RUN_BY_POLICY.
Record current source-tree cleanliness and enabled mutation flags; redact all values and classify unresolved release blockers.
Run the Phase 7 contract test, then write the reconciliation matrix and eight ordered operation results with identity and source digests.
stages.dataFlow: HEAD + migration files + health/schema/workflow contracts + owner decision -> identity reconciliation -> target probe policy -> release blocker classification -> environment matrix
verificationCriteria: identity fields are valid and consistent
target probe is explicitly not run
stages.completionCriteria: target-environment-reconciliation-matrix.json status PASS, eight operation results PASS and stage evidence VERIFIED; otherwise 7.3 remains locked.

stages.title: Yerel artifact, smoke ve atomic dry-run yayin provasi
stages.objective: Execute the same local release gates represented by CI, construct and hash a release artifact, verify deploy contracts and perform only isolated dry-run smoke/activation checks.
stages.scope: Lint, production typecheck, hosted oracle tests, production build, release archive, deploy contract tests, workflow/nginx/hosted verifiers, smoke dry-run and isolated atomic deploy dry-run.
prerequisites: 7.2 is VERIFIED and its output/evidence digests match.
Node dependencies are installed from app/package-lock.json.
The local build can run with provider/channel/remote mutation disabled.
A temporary directory is available for the dry-run deploy pointer and release directory.
architectureDecisions: The local gate uses NODE_ENV=production and the exact release identity contract but does not enable real dependencies.
The archive manifest must bind commit SHA, migration fingerprint, release ID, compatibility version and archive SHA-256.
Deploy verification uses a temporary work root and dry-run mode; no /opt path, SSH, PM2 restart, remote smoke or rollback is performed.
The deploy machinery test is filtered to deterministic contract, local server and dry-run cases; the test that installs/overwrites workflows is not executed.
A passing local release gate proves artifact/deploy machinery consistency only; it is not a production GO signal.
GitHub workflow and target environment files are read or validated locally; no workflow dispatch is sent.
Production deployment, linked Supabase migration apply, remote restore, remote worker start and target writes are forbidden.
Real WhatsApp, Telegram, email, Stripe and external AI/provider egress remain disabled.
Only local build output, isolated temporary dry-run state and secret-free audit evidence may be written.
The phase may preserve a production NO-GO decision; technical closure must never be interpreted as production approval.
No commit, branch push, secret rotation or remote configuration change is performed by this phase.
operations: Read and digest 7.2 evidence and confirm its release identity before starting any build.
Run lint, production typecheck and hosted oracle tests with safe local environment flags.
Run the production build and verify the generated service-worker/release identity boundary.
Build the hosted release archive and outer manifest, then validate commit, fingerprint, release ID, compatibility version and archive hash.
Run deterministic deploy machinery tests, workflow hardening, nginx validation and hosted sandbox contract verification.
Run the smoke checker in explicit dry-run mode; do not provide a live base URL.
Run atomic deploy in a unique temporary directory with artifact-required and dry-run flags; remove the temporary directory after capture.
Persist the release-gate matrix, command summaries, artifact digest and eight ordered operation results only when every command is PASS.
stages.dataFlow: source tree -> lint/typecheck/oracle tests -> .next -> release archive + manifest -> deploy contract checks -> dry-run activation/smoke -> release gate evidence
verificationCriteria: artifact identity and archive hash match
deploy tests pass without workflow installation
temporary deploy state is isolated and cleaned
stages.completionCriteria: release-gate-matrix.json status PASS, eight operation results PASS and stage evidence VERIFIED; otherwise 7.4 remains locked.

stages.title: Nihai teknik kapanis ve yayin kararinin kilitlenmesi
stages.objective: Revalidate every Phase 7 stage and digest, record the final release identity and preserve the truthful production NO-GO decision until all owner-controlled gates are complete.
stages.scope: Phase 7 state machine, stage evidence, output digests, final local gate results, production decision, release blocker list, mutation boundary and final closure record.
prerequisites: Every Phase 7 output and stage evidence digest matches its recorded value.
Final contract and release-gate tests are PASS.
architectureDecisions: Phase 7 technical closure is CLOSED only when all ordered operations, digest checks and final tests pass.
The final release decision remains NO-GO when owner actions, live target evidence, clean release commit or explicit approval are unresolved.
phase-7-closure.json records no next phase unlock; post-closure production actions require a separate owner-authorized operation outside this audit.
The closure record is secret-free, immutable for the captured source commit and explicit about every unexecuted live action.
GitHub workflow and target environment files are read or validated locally; no workflow dispatch is sent.
Production deployment, linked Supabase migration apply, remote restore, remote worker start and target writes are forbidden.
Real WhatsApp, Telegram, email, Stripe and external AI/provider egress remain disabled.
Only local build output, isolated temporary dry-run state and secret-free audit evidence may be written.
The phase may preserve a production NO-GO decision; technical closure must never be interpreted as production approval.
No commit, branch push, secret rotation or remote configuration change is performed by this phase.
operations: Read 7.1, 7.2 and 7.3 states; stop if any stage is not VERIFIED.
Recompute every prior output and evidence SHA-256 digest and compare them to the state.
Reconcile source commit, current identity, working-tree state and phase plan manifest.
Run the final Phase 7 contract test and require PASS.
Require release-gate command summary and artifact identity to remain PASS and consistent.
Require productionDecision NO-GO, ownerActionsRequired non-empty, liveActionsExecuted empty and mustNotClaim intact.
Require every mutation-policy flag to remain closed and record deferred release blockers without converting them into fabricated passes.
Write phase-7 closure evidence, state and closure record; mark CLOSED only after operations 1-7 pass and set nextPhaseUnlocked to false.
stages.dataFlow: stage evidence + artifact/gate results + owner decision -> digest revalidation -> final checks -> NO-GO blocker classification -> CLOSED technical phase -> locked production decision
verificationCriteria: production decision is truthful NO-GO where required
closure state is CLOSED and next phase remains locked
stages.completionCriteria: phase-7-closure-evidence.json and phase-7-closure.json are written with status CLOSED, eight closure operations PASS, productionDecision NO-GO and nextPhaseUnlocked false.

localOnlyBoundary: workflow and target files are read locally; no dispatch
no production, Supabase, SSH, provider, channel or billing mutation
only local build, isolated temp dry-run and secret-free evidence writes
